painpoints.text: planner-preflight.nu in-flight arm mislabeled seeds-e218 as in_flight (run 01M2ZW7TT6KKBR8RSS60ZBSEDR) even though that run's status is failed/terminal with no PR; only cross-checking fabro_runs_list resolved it. Suggest the arm exclude terminal-status runs (failed/completed) without an open PR from the in-flight mapping, else every resume-after-failure seed will be wrongly skipped.

The seed's rescue pointer references branch name origin/fabro/run/... but the ref only resolves as FETCH_HEAD after an explicit fetch of the run branch (bare clone does not carry other runs' branches). Planner had to discover the fetch step; worth a note in the develop docs or seed-template guidance (run 01M2ZYVQ7CBSY3T0FEYBE9JK74).

observations: seeds-e218 claimed as a RESUME: prior run 01M2ZW7TT6KK died on a missing-python3 toolchain image (since fixed and repinned, qualitygate verified green against that branch locally per seed body); its branch tip 7d9ab1b is an implementer-success carrying the full format core.
Seed has no Basis: line (created 2026-09-20, judged per legacy rule): acceptance criteria fully resolve against the current tree once the prior branch is merged.

Preflight anchor_flags showed all four cited paths missing_file — expected: those paths exist on the prior-attempt branch, not on main; the anchors resolve against the starting-point branch, not the current worktree.

painpoints: scripts/verify.nu derives touched crates from a hardcoded `lib/(apps|components|foundation)/` path regex (line ~72-82); this repo's crates live in `crates/`, so `just verify implementer` answered 'no lib/ crates touched — nothing to verify' for a pure-Rust diff (run 01M2ZYVQ7CBSY3T0FEYBE9JK74, implementer). Fix: derive crate paths from the workspace manifest instead of the hardcoded layout.

dup-run-check.nu returned verdict degraded, reason 'fetch failed: fatal: couldn't find remote ref denkhaus' (run 01M2ZYVQ7CBSY3T0FEYBE9JK74) — the script's fetch assumes a remote/ref shape this origin doesn't serve; proceeded per degraded policy but the check gave no signal.

`ml` is unusable: no .mulch/ directory exists anywhere in the repo and `ml prime` fails with 'No .mulch/ directory found. Run `mulch init`' — AGENTS.md mandates ml prime/record every session. Either init mulch in this repo or drop the mandate.

Durable lesson that ml record could not capture: crates/seeds/tests/real_fixture.rs compares a frozen sd-list snapshot against the LIVE .seeds/issues.jsonl; any tracker mutation after fixture capture (e.g. planner claim bumping updatedAt, run 01M2ZYVQ7CBSY3T0FEYBE9JK74) red-lines the suite. Regenerate the fixture (sd list --all --format json --limit 200) in the same pass, or copy the tracker to a temp dir in the test.
observations: Fixture regeneration is load-bearing for the tester step: between implementer and tester, no sd mutation is expected, but any closeout-time tracker write would race the real-fixture test if suites re-ran afterwards.
